premises.text: Millions want to be music artists but lack producer access or money
premises.evidence_span: There are millions of people around the world that have a burning desire to be a music artist

premises.text: Mobile all-in-one marketplace lets users make original songs with producers for under $5 from their phone
premises.evidence_span: create original songs with award-winning music producers for under $5. all from the palm of their hand

premises.text: Beat discovery, recording, video shoot, and social sharing turn friends into fans
premises.evidence_span: they can share it across all their social networks, including Rekogram's social networks, instantly turning their friends into fans

premises.text: Producers with great beats lack artist relationships; artists lack affordable access to those producers
premises.evidence_span: he doesn't have relationships with artists to sell his production

premises.text: Subscription upload fees plus 20% of in-app beat leases/sales with 50% royalties to producers
premises.evidence_span: when those beats are leased or sold through our platform, we take 20% of the in-app purchase, and we provide 50% of the royalties back to the producer

premises.text: Promotion via music-space affiliates, field reps, and celebrity fan callouts
premises.evidence_span: we also have eight field reps in major markets across the country that are our evangelists

premises.text: Original-content platform avoids major-label licensing dependence that competitors have
premises.evidence_span: The difference between us and our competitors is that we're not relying on major label licensing because we're an original content platform

value.text: Producers earn and aspiring artists get affordable access to create original music
value.evidence_span: we make money for producers like Tony, and we provide access and save money for guys like Willie

causal_links.evidence_span: Rekogram solves both Tony and Willie's problems
bring that collaboration and discovery process to the mobile device
charge producers $9.99 a month or $90 a year

notes: Demo connection failures ignored. Competitor user counts/valuations excluded as market color, not premises.
